Aber woran liegt das eigentlich? Und wie kann man Kindern Gemuse schmackhaft machen - ohne Zwang, ohne Drama? Lege setzt auf Wissen, Geschmack und einfache Rezepte. In seiner "Lernkuche" zeigt er, wie man Gemusesorten so zubereitet, dass sie Kindern wirklich schmecken.Doch Theorie und Praxis gehoren zusammen. Deshalb organisiert Lege fur die Kinder einen Ausflug auf einen Bauernhof. Dort lernen sie, was hinter dem steckt, was oft wie selbstverstandlich auf dem Teller landet. Wie lange braucht eine Kartoffel in der Erde, bis man sie ernten kann? Wie funktioniert Dungung? Was bedeutet Schadlingsbefall? Die Kinder graben, pflanzen, ernten und begreifen: Essen ist Arbeit, Natur, Geduld. Und es verdient Respekt.Und weil Kinder SuSSes lieben, spannt Lege den Bogen weiter: SuSSes muss nicht ungesund sein. In der Schulmensa hat er beim letzten Besuch Vanillepudding aus dem Eimer gesehen - voller Zucker, Vanillin, Zusatzstoffe. Das geht besser. In seiner Kuche bereitet er einen Schokopudding aus SuSSkartoffeln zu.Coach Edith, eine erfahrene Ernahrungswissenschaftlerin, gibt den Lehrern und Betreuern wichtige Impulse. Wie lernen Kinder essen? Was tun, wenn sie nichts mogen? Soll man sie zwingen? Überreden? Oder lieber Alternativen anbieten? Edith liefert praxisnahe Antworten - und gibt dem Kollegium Werkzeuge an die Hand.Dann der groSSe Moment: Das Caterer-Casting startet. Zwei neue Anbieter liefern je eine Woche lang frisch gekochtes Essen - und die Kinder durfen mitentscheiden, wer kunftig die Schule beliefern soll. Bewertet werden Geschmack, Aussehen, Vielfalt - und naturlich: Was bleibt auf dem Teller?Als endlich auch der Umzug in die neue Mensa ansteht, helfen alle mit: Eltern, Kinder, Lehrkrafte. Es wird geschleppt, dekoriert, geputzt - und zum ersten Mal entsteht ein Ort, an dem essen mehr ist als nur satt zu werden.Beim groSSen Wiedersehen mit Sebastian Lege zeigt sich: Es ist wirklich etwas passiert. Der Schulgarten gedeiht. Die Kinder wissen, wo ihr Gemuse herkommt. Der neue Caterer liefert frisch, gesund und lecker. Die neue Mensa ist lebendig und einladend.Und vielleicht das Schonste: Aus skeptischen Essern sind neugierige Geschmackshelden und Geschmacksheldinnen geworden.

programme.title: Agency, annoyance and freedom - where are we in the east? / Einigkeit, Verdruss und Freiheit - Wo stehen wir im Osten?
programme.desc: On October 3, 1990, two German states became Germany. Everything was different for the people from the GDR. Little for the people in the West. How are we united today? The annoyance in the country, the dissatisfaction, seem to be gaining weight - especially in the east. But what are the reason for that? How do people look today, 35 years after reunification, their home, their life and the "system" Federal Republic? Birgit Warnke's film is looking for traces and sprints in the east - for example at a pub evening in the small Thuringian village of Niederbosa. The AfD recently won more than 60 percent. Where does dissatisfaction come from in the idyllic 130-soul community? Or at the nationwide largest Simson meeting in Zwickau, which attracts many young men, who celebrate their GDR cult mopeds and their East German identity for four days. The Doku also has the history of Petra Peterhansel, which has done its training at Wartburg in the VEB Automobilwerk Eisenach and is now heading the BMW plant in Leipzig. She is one of the few East Germans that made it into a top position. Just one exception? Why are East German in the East Germans still underrapsed in the East German in Fuhrung? And what did it do with the east that the population has shrunk by 15 percent since 1990 and so many people migrated to the West? He is the front man of the punk band "Feine Sahne Fischfilet", who is committed to right -wing radicalism. "Monchi" was born in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, there would be no option to go to the West. The documentary accompanies him on his "Wasted in Jarmen" festival with which he and his band liked to look at what connects and not to what separates. For "Monchi", political differences are not necessarily east -west, but above all a question from the city and country. And then there are the former NVA officers who are still meeting regularly today and exchanged about reunification - as it has run. Also because they had imagined their lives very differently. For a long time, they no longer have everything to say - especially when it comes to their view of Russia, which is fundamentally different from the majority opinion. How do different experiences, perspectives and identities? In the film, prominent East Germans - like actress Christiane Paul, the political legend Gregor Gysi, sociologist Steffen Mau, director Christian Schwochow and journalist Valerie Schonian. / Am 3. Oktober 1990 wurde aus zwei deutschen Staaten ein Deutschland. Fur die Menschen aus der DDR anderte sich alles. Fur die Menschen im Westen nur wenig. Wie vereint sind wir heute?Der Verdruss im Land, die Unzufriedenheit, scheinen zuzunehmen - vor allem im Osten. Aber was sind dafur die Grunde? Wie blicken die Menschen heute, 35 Jahre nach der Wiedervereinigung, auf ihre Heimat, ihr Leben und das "System" Bundesrepublik?Der Film von Birgit Warnke geht auf Spurensuche und spurt den Stimmungen im Osten nach - etwa bei einem Kneipenabend in dem kleinen thuringischen Dorf Niederbosa. Dort haben mehr als 60 Prozent zuletzt die AfD gewahlt. Woher kommt die Unzufriedenheit in der idyllischen 130-Seelengemeinde? Oder bei dem bundesweit groSSten Simsontreffen in Zwickau, das vor allem viele junge Manner anzieht, die vier Tage ihre DDR-Kult-Mopeds und ihre ostdeutsche Identitat feiern.Die Doku erzahlt auch die Geschichte von Petra Peterhansel, die in der DDR im VEB Automobilwerk Eisenach ihre Ausbildung bei Wartburg gemacht hat und mittlerweile das BMW-Werk in Leipzig leitet. Sie ist eine der wenigen Ostdeutschen, die es in eine Spitzenposition geschafft hat. Nur eine Ausnahme?Warum sind 35 Jahre nach der Einheit Ostdeutsche in Fuhrung immer noch so unterreprasentiert? Und was hat es mit dem Osten gemacht, dass die Bevolkerung seit 1990 um 15 Prozent geschrumpft ist und so viele Menschen in den Westen abgewandert sind?Immer im Osten geblieben ist Jan "Monchi" Gorkow. Er ist Frontmann der Punkband "Feine Sahne Fischfilet", die sich gegen Rechtsradikalismus engagiert. "Monchi" ist in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern geboren, fur ihn ware es keine Option in den Westen zu gehen. Die Doku begleitet ihn auf sein "Wasted in Jarmen"-Festival mit dem er und seine Band auf das schauen mochten, was verbindet und nicht auf das, was trennt. Fur "Monchi" sind politische Unterschiede nicht unbedingt Ost-West Unterschiede, sondern vor allem eine Frage von Stadt und Land.Und dann sind da noch die ehemaligen NVA-Offiziere, die sich heute noch regelmaSSig treffen und uber die Wiedervereinigung - so wie sie gelaufen ist - enttauscht sind. Auch, weil sie sich ihren Lebensweg ganz anders vorgestellt hatten. Langst haben sie das Gefuhl nicht mehr alles sagen zu durfen - vor allem, wenn es um ihren Blick auf Russland geht, der sich von der Mehrheitsmeinung fundamental unterscheidet. Wie pragen unterschiedliche Erfahrungen, Sichtweisen und Identitaten?Davon erzahlen im Film auch prominente Ostdeutsche - wie die Schauspielerin Christiane Paul, die Politlegende Gregor Gysi, der Soziologe Steffen Mau, der Regisseur Christian Schwochow und die Journalistin Valerie Schonian.

Als dann auch noch die junge und schwangere Marie-Louise Scholler, die fur das Opfer gearbeitet hat, ins Visier der Ermittlungen ruckt, nimmt der Verlauf eine unerwartete Wendung.Die Polizisten setzen alles in Bewegung, um den Fall zu losen, damit dem Verstorbenen endlich die letzte Ehre erwiesen werden kann.

programme.title: SOKE / SOKO Wismar
programme.desc: Elisabeth Zimmermann falls down a staircase and dies. But it was apparently not an accident, because her injuries indicate that the pensioner was piled up. Formal doctor Helene Sturbeck is a very personal case this time, because Elisabeth's son Martin Zimmermann is her past great love. When the two suddenly stand back to each other after all the years, they can hardly believe it. Elisabeth Zimmermann had many enemies during their lifetime, some of them even threw her death. Above all, her neighbor, the master carpenter Jens-Peter Hilbert, whom she had sued ice cold and thus threatened his existence. Has Hilbert wanted to end the neighborhood dispute once and for all and do something to the dispute -good pensioner? But her son Martin is also compatible. He had fought violently with his mother shortly before her death because she had interfered in his marriage. When Helene finds out that he gave her the suspect injuries to the forearms, the question arises: Has Martin Zimmermann now defended himself after many years of terrorization by his mother? / Elisabeth Zimmermann fallt eine Treppe hinunter und stirbt. Doch es war scheinbar kein Unfall, denn ihre Verletzungen deuten darauf hin, dass die Rentnerin gestoSSen wurde.Fur Rechtsmedizinerin Helene Sturbeck ist es diesmal ein ganz personlicher Fall, denn Elisabeths Sohn Martin Zimmermann ist ihre verflossene groSSe Liebe. Als die beiden nach all den Jahren plotzlich wieder voreinanderstehen, konnen sie es kaum glauben.Elisabeth Zimmermann hatte zu Lebzeiten viele Feinde, manche von ihnen haben ihr sogar den Tod gewunscht. Allen voran ihr Nachbar, der Tischlermeister Jens-Peter Hilbert, den sie eiskalt verklagt und so seine Existenz bedroht hatte. Hat Hilbert den Nachbarschaftsstreit ein fur alle Mal beenden wollen und der streitsuchtigen Rentnerin etwas angetan?Aber auch ihr Sohn Martin macht sich verdachtig. Er hatte sich kurz vor ihrem Tod heftig mit seiner Mutter gestritten, weil sie sich in seine Ehe eingemischt hatte. Als Helene herausfindet, dass er ihr die verdachtigen Verletzungen an den Unterarmen zugefugt hat, steht die Frage im Raum: Hat sich Martin Zimmermann nach vielen Jahren der Terrorisierung durch seine Mutter nun doch zur Wehr gesetzt?

programme.desc: In the garden house of the exclusive yoga and wellness resort in Maiberghof, a shocking discovery is made: the respected Cambô practitioner Simon Kern was tied up and suffocated. programme.title: The game - Michael Douglas / המשחק - מייקל דאגלס
programme.desc: thriller. Investment banker receives a gift from his younger brother for his 48th birthday - a gift certificate for a dangerous game that will change his life forever. With Michael Douglas, Sean Penn, directed by David Pinzer (Arb, 1997). / מותחן. בנקאי השקעות מקבל ליום הולדתו ה-48 מתנה מאחיו הצעיר - תעודת שי למשחק מסוכן שעתיד לשנות את חייו לעד. עם מייקל דאגלס, שון פן, בימוי דייוויד פינצר (ארהב, 1997).

programme.title: King Kong - Naomi Watts / קינג קונג - נעמי ווטס
programme.desc: Adventures. A spectacular new version, which won the 3 Academy Awards, to the famous story of the huge gorilla revealed by a team that comes to film a movie on a mysterious island. With Naomi Watts, Adrian Brody. Directed by Peter Gaxon (Arb, 2005). (Shekel) / הרפתקאות. גרסה חדשה ומרהיבה, שזכתה ב-3 פרסי אוסקר, לסיפור המפורסם על הגורילה הענקית שמתגלה עי צוות המגיע לצלם סרט באי מסתורי. עם נעמי ווטס, אדריאן ברודי. בימוי פיטר גקסון (ארהב, 2005). (שח)

programme.title: Nobody's son - El Petzino - new on the channel! / בן של אף אחד - אל פאצינו - חדש בערוץ!
programme.desc: drama. A promising young policeman from New York returns to the distress neighborhood where he grows up with the secret of his past, who threatens to destroy his life and his family's life. With El Fatino, Tatum Tsangs. Directed by Ditto Montel (Arb, 2011). (Shekel) / דרמה. שוטר צעיר ומבטיח מניו יורק חוזר לשכונת המצוקה בה גדל ומתמודד עם סוד מעברו, שמאיים להרוס את חייו ואת חיי משפחתו. עם אל פאצינו, צנינג טאטום. בימוי דיטו מונטל (ארהב, 2011). (שח)

programme.title: War dogs (2024) / כלבי מלחמה (2024)
programme.desc: action. After a mission of sword employees, the only one who survives goes out to avenge his brother's death to weapons. With Frank Grillo, Robert Patrick, Rona Mitra. Directed by Isaac Florentine. (Arb, 2024) (Shekel) / פעולה. לאחר שמשימה של שכירי חרב משתבשת, היחיד מבניהם שנותר בחיים יוצא לנקום את מותם של אחיו לנשק. עם פרנק גרילו, רוברט פטריק, רונה מיטרה. בימוי אייזיק פלורנטין. (ארהב, 2024) (שח)

programme.title: Apartment 7A / דירה 7א
programme.desc: terror. After a dancer starts with a serious injury, she finds herself continuing dark forces with a strange and linked adults promise her a chance to glory. With Garia Garner. Directed by Natalie Erica Games. (Arb, 2024) (Shekel) / אימה. לאחר שרקדנית מתחילה עוברת פציעה קשה, היא מוצאת את עצמה נמשכת עי כוחות אפלים כאשר זוג מבוגרים מוזרים ומקושרים מבטיחים לה הזדמנות לתהילה. עם גוליה גארנר. בימוי נטלי אריקה גיימס. programme.title: The British Gov - Glow their deviation / הגוב הבריטי - גייסון סטייתם
programme.desc: A thriller according to a true story. A former criminal, who is tempted by another robbery, reveals that the loot includes revealing photos of senior personality and tries to escape the problem without a hit. With Gaison their deviation, directed by Ruger Donaldson (England, 2008). (Shekel) / מותחן על פי סיפור אמיתי. פושע לשעבר, המתפתה לשוד אחד נוסף, מגלה כי השלל כולל תמונות חושפניות של אישיות בכירה ומנסה להיחלץ מהבעיה ללא פגע. עם גייסון סטייתם, בימוי רוגר דונלדסון (אנגליה, 2008). programme.title: Made in America (2017) - Tom Cruise / תוצרת אמריקה (2017) - טום קרוז
programme.desc: Action, crime. Based on a true story. An American pilot becomes a smuggling drug working for the CIA on a secret mission to expose the arms sales affair to Iran in the 1980s. With Tom Cruise, Donel Galison. May Doug Lyman (Arb, 2017). (Shekel) / פעולה, פשע. מבוסס על סיפור אמיתי. טייס אמריקאי הופך למבריח סמים העובד עבור הסי-אי-איי במשימה חשאית לחשוף את פרשת מכירת הנשק לאיראן בשנות ה-80. עם טום קרוז, דונל גליסון. במאי דאג לימן (ארהב, 2017).(שח)

programme.title: At the top rose - Devin Gonson / בראש מורם - דווין גונסון
programme.desc: action. A liberated soldier who returns to his hometown reveals that there is now a crime, drug and violence, and decides to clean the streets on his own. With De Rock, Goni Noxville, directed by Kevin Bray (Arb, 2004). (Shekel) / פעולה. חייל משוחרר אשר שב לעיירת הולדתו, מגלה כי במקום שולטים כעת פשע, סמים ואלימות, ומחליט לנקות את הרחובות בכוחות עצמו. עם דה רוק, גוני נוקסוויל, בימוי קווין בריי (ארהב, 2004). (שח)

programme.title: Removed split saga / סאגת מפוצלים מורדים
programme.desc: A sequel to split. This time Beatrice must fight for her inner demons and fight the alliance that threatens to tear the company in which she lives into carrots. With Sheilin Woodley, Naomi Watts and Kate Winslet. Directed by Robert Schwantka (Arb, 2015). (Shekel) / סרט המשך למפוצלים. הפעם ביאטריס חייבת להיאבק בשדים הפנימיים שלה ולהיאבק בברית שמאיימת לקרוע את החברה בה היא חיה לגזרים. עם שיילין וודלי, נעמי ווטס וקייט ווינסלט. בימוי רוברט שוונטקה (ארהב, 2015). (שח)

programme.title: Foreign Squads - Nicole Kidman - New Channel! / מזימות זרות - ניקול קידמן - חדש בערוץ!
programme.desc: thriller. The employee's interpreter at Umm is reporting to superiors about the assassination of an assassination on which he heard. She soon receives FBI protection, but the person in charge of her suspects in her motives. With Nicole Kidman, Sean Penn. Directed by Sydney Polk (Arb, 2005). / מותחן. מתורגמנית העובדת באום מדווחת לממונים על מזימת התנקשות עליה שמעה. עד מהרה היא זוכה להגנת ה-FBI אך הסוכן המופקד על הגנתה חושד במניעיה. עם ניקול קידמן, שון פן. בימוי סידני פולאק (ארהב, 2005).

programme.title: Beauty UFC 317 / MMA UFC 317
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Red Star - Milan / Košarka - Euroleague: Crvena zvezda - Milano
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

Budite uz nas i saznajte najbitnije novosti o najvećem klupskom takmičenju na svetu!

programme.title: Football - Champion League: Kairat - Real Madrid / Fudbal - Liga šampiona: Kairat - Real Madrid
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Kansas City Chiefs - Baltimore Ravens / Američki fudbal - NFL: Kansas City Chiefs - Baltimore Ravens
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Bayern / Košarka - Euroleague: Panathinaikos - Bayern
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Monaco - Zalgiris / Košarka - Euroleague: Monaco - Zalgiris
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Football - Champions League: Multiprenos / Fudbal - Liga šampiona: Multiprenos
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Baskonia - Olympiacos / Košarka - Euroleague: Baskonia - Olympiacos
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path set after the hand of Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team of Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Game plan / Plan igre
programme.desc: A football coach analyst will talk about a few games from the Prime Minister League about how football looks like and how it should look. We will try to focus on football, not to get off the football field, and give the answer to the question of what is that separating the teams on those who lose, or often win. Our vision and our guests, experts in football field. / Fudbalski trener analitičar će na primeru nekoliko utakmica iz Premijer lige govoriti o tome kako fudbal izgleda i kako bi trebalo da izgleda. Pokušaćemo da se fokusiramo na sam fudbal, da ne silazimo sa fudbalskog terena, i da damo odgovor na pitanje šta je to što razdvaja ekipe na one koje gube i one koje pobeđuju, odnosno često pobeđuju. programme.title: Basketball - Germany League: Ulm - Chemnitz / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Ulm - Chemnitz
programme.desc: The history of the German club basketball dates back to 1939. years, but the German basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964. while only the competition sets two years later. The last two of the regular part of the regular part drop out in the lower rank, while the Plejofor gets the Best of Five format where the teams must receive minimum 3 matches from 5 to eject the rivals. The interestingness of the league is that each team must have a hall of a minimum of 3000 places for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Radnik - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Široki Brijeg

programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.sub-title: R: Lara Simona Taufer... Niko Goršicˇ je vsestranski gledališki ustvarjalec, igralec, performer, režiser in vesten spremljevalec odrske umetnosti, od gledališcˇa do plesa.
programme.desc: He has played countless roles in theater, film and on television, and directed more than thirty theater performances and still actively creates. The documentary portrait of this extremely vital and tirelessly artistically engaged eighty -year -old has a movement or walking for the red thread. Niko Goršič takes 10,000 steps every day as part of an art campaign. In the documentary, we follow his steps along the former and current theater paths, with his narrative complemented by various companions from the past and present. / Odigral je nešteto vlog v gledališcˇu, filmu in na televiziji ter režiral vecˇ kot trideset gledaliških predstav in še vedno aktivno ustvarja. Niko Goršič namreč vsak dan kot del umetniške akcije naredi 10.000 korakov. programme.title: S-Prehodi: Sonja Novak-Lukanovic, Director of the Institute for Ethnic Studies, Mon. / S-prehodi: Sonja Novak – Lukanovič, direktorica Inštituta za narodnostna vprašanja, pon.
programme.desc: This time we are devoting the submission of the centenary of the Institute for Ethnic Studies. As a successor to the minority institute, founded in 1925 in Ljubljana, he pre -established one of the first research institutions in the field of minority studies in the world. It was created to study the position of Slovenes in neighboring countries, the situation of the German and Hungarian minorities in Slovenia, and in the atmosphere of the creation of international minority protection within the Association of Nations and European Minority Congresses. With us is the director of the Institute for Ethnic Studies, dr. Sonja Novak Lukanovic. / Tokrat oddajo namenjamo obeležitvi stoletnice Inštituta za narodnostna vprašanja. Kot naslednik Manjšinskega inštituta, ustanovljenega leta 1925 v Ljubljani, je predstvljal eno prvih raziskovalnih institucij s področja manjšinskih študij na svetu. Nastal je z namenom proučevanja položaja Slovencev v sosednjih državah, položaja nemške in madžarske manjšine v Sloveniji ter v ozračju nastajanja mednarodne manjšinske zaščite v okviru Društva narodov in Evropskih manjšinskih kongresov. Z nami je direktorica Inštituta za narodnostna vprašanja dr. Sonja Novak Lukanovič.

programme.desc: R: Amir Muratović ... In the show we are preparing an interview with a French sociologist, philosopher and essayist Didier Eribon, who was a recent guest of the City of Book Festival in Nova Gorica. We talked about his growing up in the working class and the breakthrough in the intellectual elite, why he understands the homes for the elderly as the spaces of systemic violence, how the loss of physical autonomy affects the loss of the individual's political voice, and why the task of thinking the voice of vulnerable groups is to be transferred to the public sphere. We present the history of the City of Women, who has been creating space for creators and theorists for twenty years, points to the problems they face, as well as their inequality and neglect, which is still present in several areas. We will talk about the importance of the festival and his vision in the studio with the program manager Ivo Kovač. Renovation is becoming an increasingly important task for architects and therefore sees it as part of a circular economy. This was also the central theme of the International Conference, which took place at the Faculty of Architecture, which discussed that in Slovenia, the revival of abandoned immovable cultural heritage with flexible reuse could also contribute significantly to the achievement of sustainable development goals and to the green transition. / R: Amir Muratović... V oddaji pripravljamo intervju s francoskim sociologom, filozofom in esejistom Didierjem Eribonom, ki je bil nedavno častni gost festivala Mesto knjige v Novi Gorici. Pogovarjali smo se o njegovem odraščanju v delavskem razredu in preboju v intelektualno elito, o tem, zakaj domove za starejše razume kot prostore sistemskega nasilja, kako izguba fizične avtonomije vpliva na izgubo političnega glasu posameznika in o tem, zakaj je naloga mislecev, da glas ranljivih skupin prenesejo v javno sfero. Predstavljamo zgodovino festivala Mesto žensk, ki že dvajset let ustvarja prostor za ustvarjalke in teoretičarke, opozarja na težave, s katerimi se spoprijemajo, pa tudi na njihovo neenakopravnost in zapostavljenost, ki je na več področjih še vedno prisotna. O pomenu festivala in njegovi viziji bomo v studiu govorili s programsko vodjo Ivo Kovač. Prenova postaja vedno bolj pomembna naloga arhitektov in zato jo vidijo kot del krožnega gospodarstva. To je bila tudi osrednja tema mednarodne konference, ki je potekala na Fakulteti za arhitekturo in na kateri so razpravljali o tem, da lahko tudi v Sloveniji oživljanje opuščene nepremične kulturne dediščine s prilagodljivo ponovno uporabo pomembno prispeva k doseganju ciljev trajnostnega razvoja in k zelenemu prehodu.

programme.title: Renaissance: beauty and blood: salvation, British documentary series, 3/3, Mon. / Renesansa: lepota in kri: Odrešitev, britanska dokumentarna serija, 3/3, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Emma Frank... Renaissance: The Blood And The Beauty; Dokumentarna serija raziskuje vzpon, tekmovalnost in dediščino treh največjih renesančnih umetnikov – Michelangela, Leonarda da Vincija in Rafaela. V ozadju njihove umetnosti se razkrivajo političn
programme.desc: Part 3.: Leonardo da Vinci went to Milan and then to France, in Rome between Michelangelo and Rafael still ruled a competition that promoted their creativity. By order of Pope Julius II. Michelangelo started painting the Sistine Chapel ceiling, while Rafael had the task of painting a hall not far away, in which the pope accepted important statesmen. July II. was succeeded by Pope Leon X., who made political agreements with art and thus sought to defend himself against the attacks of the French. Leonardo left the world the first of the three giants of the Italian Renaissance. Rafael, on request of the Pope, created tapestries for the Sistine Chapel, and shortly afterwards he also left. The Protestant Reformation spread throughout Europe at the time and also stumbled on the Italian peninsula. In a deep division between loyalty to the client and religion, Michelangelo was hidden for two months from attacks raging in Florence. He decided to pour his deepest feelings in the last period, and at that time the last judgment was created. Renaissance: The Blood and the Beauty / UK / 2024 / Director: Emma Frank. / 3. del: OdrešitevKo je Leonardo da Vinci odšel v Milano in nato v Francijo, je v Rimu med Michelangelom in Rafaelom še vedno vladala tekmovalnost, ki je spodbujala njuno ustvarjalnost. Po naročilu papeža Julija II. se je Michelangelo lotil poslikave stropa Sikstinske kapele, medtem pa je imel Rafael nalogo, da nedaleč stran poslika dvorano, v kateri je papež sprejemal pomembne državnike. Julija II. je nasledil papež Leon X., ki je z umetnostjo sklepal politične dogovore in se tako skušal ubraniti pred napadi Francozov. Leonardo je prvi od treh velikanov italijanske renesanse zapustil svet. Rafael je po naročilu papeža ustvaril tapiserije za Sikstinsko kapelo, kmalu zatem pa je tudi on prerano odšel. Protestantska reformacija se je takrat razširila po vsej Evropi in tudi na italijanskem polotoku zanetila nemir. V globoki razklanosti med zvestobo naročnikom in vero se je Michelangelo dva meseca skrival pred napadi, ki so divjali v Firencah. Odločil se je, da bo v zadnjem obdobju v umetnost prelil svoja najgloblja občutja, in takrat je nastala Poslednja sodba.RENAISSANCE: THE BLOOD AND THE BEAUTY / Velika Britanija / 2024 / Režija: Emma Frank.

programme.title: As if it were yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Swiss army, infinite crisis? by Françoise Weilhammer and Xavier Nicolsono the times in which the Swiss militia army was a source of national pride. Reduced effective, need for modernization, resignation from key places, corruption scandals, management problems. For months the worrying news follows each other without stopping. Our army seems to be no longer appropriate to today's needs and its degree of defense is alarming. Is Switzerland's security in danger? Will the new federal councilor Martin Pfister be able to correct the shot in an increasingly complex and unstable geopolitical situation? Migros, a hundred years of service and strategy of Laurent nègre and François Roulet Migros, one of the major groups of large retailers in Switzerland, celebrates the 100th anniversary this year. In 1925, Gottlieb Duttweiler, Swiss entrepreneur and politician, Fonda Migros, a small commercial enterprise that proposes a novelty: buying and distributing goods passing directly from the manufacturer to the final consumer and this in order to reduce prices. Duttweiler is considered a visionary of the retail trade that he fought to improve the daily life of customers and collaborators. But what remains of this humanist and social approach to Migros employees today? How has this exemplary company over time become a powerful group over time with a turnover of 32 billion francs? / Esercito svizzero, crisi infinita? di Françoise Weilhammer e Xavier NicolSono lontani i tempi nei quali l’Esercito di milizia svizzero era motivo di orgoglio nazionale. Effettivi ridotti, necessità di modernizzazione, dimissioni dai posti chiave, scandali di corruzione, problemi di gestione. Da mesi le notizie preoccupanti si susseguono senza sosta. Il nostro Esercito sembra non essere più adeguato alle esigenze odierne e il suo grado di difesa è allarmante. La sicurezza della Svizzera è forse in pericolo? Riuscirà il nuovo Consigliere federale Martin Pfister a correggere il tiro in una situazione geopolitica sempre più complessa e instabile? Migros, cent’anni tra servizio e strategia di Laurent Nègre e François Roulet Migros, uno tra i maggiori gruppi della grande distribuzione in Svizzera, festeggia quest’anno il 100° anniversario. Nel 1925, Gottlieb Duttweiler, imprenditore e politico svizzero, fonda Migros, una piccola impresa commerciale che propone una novità: acquistare e distribuire merci passando direttamente dal produttore al consumatore finale e questo allo scopo di ridurre i prezzi. Duttweiler è considerato un visionario del commercio al dettaglio che ha lottato per migliorare la vita quotidiana di clienti e collaboratori. Ma cosa resta oggi di questo approccio umanista e sociale per i dipendenti Migros? Come si è trasformata nel tempo questa esemplare azienda diventata negli anni un potente gruppo con un fatturato di 32 miliardi di franchi?

programme.title: Treasures of the world - Canal du Midi / Tesori del Mondo - Canal du Midi
programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. We know them. A series that punctures the RSI schedule makes us know the great treasures of the planet that hosts us. The Canal du Midi or Canal des Deux Mers (in Occitan: Canal de Las Doas Mars / Canal of Miègjorn) is an artificial channel that is located in MIDI, in fact, between the cities of Toulouse and Sète, port on the Mediterranean Sea which was founded precisely as the term of the canal. In the original intentions of the seventeenth century, the construction of the Canal du Midi was to connect the Atlantic Locean and the Mediterranean, thus avoiding the long circumnavigation of Spain (allepocate enemy country) and the risk of running into piracy actions, allowing to save a journey lasting about a month. The work was officially inaugurated on May 15, 1681 with the name of Canal Royal de Languedoc. It was built under the supervision of Pierre-Paul Riquet, a rich landlord who went bankrupt due to large costs incurred and died in 1680, a few months before opening the channel navigation. The construction requested the work of 12,000 workers for a period of 15 years. / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita. Il Canal du Midi o Canal des Deux Mers (in occitano: Canal de las Doas Mars / Canal del Miègjorn) è un canale artificiale che si trova nel Midi, appunto, tra le città di Tolosa e Sète, porto sul Mar Mediterraneo che venne fondato proprio in quanto termine del canale. Nelle intenzioni originarie del XVII secolo la costruzione del Canal du Midi doveva collegare lOceano Atlantico e il Mediterraneo, evitando quindi la lunga circumnavigazione della Spagna (allepoca paese nemico) e il rischio di incappare in azioni di pirateria, permettendo di risparmiare un viaggio della durata di circa un mese. Lopera venne inaugurata ufficialmente il 15 maggio 1681 col nome di Canal Royal de Languedoc. Fu costruita sotto la supervisione di Pierre-Paul Riquet, un ricco possidente che andò in bancarotta a causa dgli ingenti costi sostenuti e morì nel 1680, pochi mesi prima dellapertura alla navigazione del canale. La costruzione richiese lopera di 12.000 operai per un periodo di 15 anni.

Pour changer la donne, certains pharmaciens testent la distribution des pilules à l’unite. Est-ce une vraie solution pour reduire les coûts de la sante ou de la poudre aux yeux ? « A bon entendeur » fait le point, mardi soir, dès 20h10, sur RTS1.

programme.title: Temps present / Temps present
programme.sub-title: Sarah Oberson, episode 2, la disparition dans une decennie noire
programme.desc: Little Sarah Oberson my mysteriously disappeared during a black December. In the 80s, nearly 20 children disappear. Some are dead, others have vanished. Disappearances that intervene while two killers in Pedophilic series crisscross the country, Werner Ferrari and Michel Peiry, known as the sadistic of Romont. Back on this macabre parenthesis in Swiss criminal history. A report by Wilfred Rebette and Sofia Pekmez / La petite Sarah Oberson a disparu mysterieusement au cours d’une decennie noire. Dans les annees 80, près de 20 enfants disparaissent. Certains sont retrouves morts, d’autres se sont volatilises. Ce fut le cas de Sylvie Bovet, disparue 4 mois avant Sarah Oberson. Des disparitions qui interviennent alors que deux tueurs en serie pedophiles quadrillent le pays, Werner Ferrari et Michel Peiry, connu sous le nom du sadique de Romont. Retour sur cette parenthèse macabre dans l’histoire criminelle suisse. Un reportage de Wilfred Rebetez et Sofia Pekmez

programme.title: Mountain Life - dream house wanted / Mountain Life - Traumhaus gesucht
programme.desc: From the forested mountain tops of the Blue Ridge Mountains in the east of Appalachen about soon Mountain with its grandiose alpine sports, the Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah and the picturesque peaks of the rockies to Hawaiis Tropical Mauna Loa: There are numerous remote mountains in the United States. They are the perfect jerking point for stressed city and swinged families who escape from traffic chaos, hustle and bustle and pollution. And as different as the mountain destinations are, the real estate are so different, because, dependent on budgets and giftability, there are almost everything-from the rustic log hat with wood stove to the bamboo-bungalow with a volcanic view to a full-glazed design object with a private spa. The documentary series accompanies mountain fans in their search for the dream house. / Von den bewaldeten Bergkuppen der Blue Ridge Mountains im Osten der Appalachen uber Bald Mountain mit seinen grandiosen Alpinsportmoglichkeiten, das Hochgebirgsdorf Midway in Utah und die malerischen Gipfel der Rockies bis zu Hawaiis tropischem Mauna Loa: In den Vereinigten Staaten gibt es zahlreiche abgelegene Gebirgsorte, die kaum jemand kennt. Sie sind der perfekte Ruckzugsort fur gestresste Stadter und erschopfte Familien, die vor Verkehrschaos, Hektik und Umweltverschmutzung fluchten. Und so unterschiedlich die Mountain-Destinationen sind, so verschieden sind auch die Immobilien, denn, abhangig von Budgets und Verfugbarkeit gibt es fast alles - von der rustikalen Blockhutte mit Holzofen uber den Bambus-Bungalow mit Vulkanblick bis hin zum vollverglasten Designobjekt mit privatem Spa. Die Doku-Serie begleitet Berg-Fans bei ihrer Suche nach dem Traumhaus.

programme.title: SRF Kids – Next Level / SRF Kids – Next Level
programme.sub-title: Mission Eierjagd: Welcher Klasse gelingt der Auftakt?
programme.desc: In the third season of «SRF Kids - Next Level», three primary classes from the cantons of Obwalden, Nidwalden and Lucerne give everything to dust off the large trophy and main prize: The schoolmen from Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW and Lucerne would definitely like to take nights in the Zoo - in a yurt and experience what the animals in Drive night. But until then they have to master six levels and lots of challenges. In the first episode, it becomes tricky, because the Challenge «Ruhr-Ei» not only requires teamwork, but also skill: Equipped with an loft in the mouth, an egg is to hike from child to child until it is catapulted in a nest in a nest in a nest. If the egg ends up on the floor and breaks, the fun begins from the front. In the second challenge of the first episode, it is important to conquer the "flying carpet". The kids have to complete a course without watching the ground, because that costs penalty seconds. Every second pays here, and the teams give everything to glide through the finish at lightning speed. Who keeps the nerves and can make it the fastest - the class from Sachseln ow, Dallenwil NW or Lucerne? If the first two challenges have been achieved, there is already the next challenge: at the “nasty quiz” particularly common questions await the teams. / Bei der dritten Staffel von «SRF Kids – Next Level» geben drei Primarklassen aus den Kantonen Obwalden, Nidwalden und Luzern alles, um den grossen Pokal und Hauptpreis abzustauben: Die Schulerinnen und Schuler aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW und Luzern mochten unbedingt im Zoo Zurich Nachtwandeln – also in einer Jurte ubernachten und erleben, was die Tiere in der Nacht treiben. Doch bis dahin mussen sie erst einmal sechs Level und jede Menge Challenges meistern.Schon in der ersten Folge wird es knifflig, denn die Challenge «Ruhr-Ei» verlangt nicht nur Teamwork, sondern auch Geschicklichkeit: Ausgestattet mit einem Loffel im Mund soll ein Ei von Kind zu Kind wandern, bis es mittels Bungee-Trampolin in ein Nest in luftiger Hohe katapultiert wird. Landet das Ei unsanft auf dem Boden und geht zu Bruch, beginnt der Spass von vorne.In der zweiten Challenge der ersten Folge gilt es, den «Fliegenden Teppich» zu bezwingen. Die Kids mussen einen Parcours absolvieren, ohne den Boden zu beruhren, denn das kostet Strafsekunden. Hier zahlt jede Sekunde, und die Teams geben alles, um blitzschnell durchs Ziel zu gleiten. Wer behalt die Nerven und schafft es am schnellsten – die Klasse aus Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW oder Luzern?Sind die ersten beiden Challenges geschafft, gibt es schon die nachste Herausforderung: Beim «Fiesen Quiz» warten besonders gemeine Fragen auf die Teams.
